description: Advances: mutagen.mutators, mutagen.mutation_enumeration, mutagen.mutation_pipeline, mutagen.coverage Ready-for: implement ## Context `mutagen_ex` does not look inside inline HEEx `~H` sigils (`{:sigil_H, meta, [{:<<>>, bin_meta, [template]}, []]}`). Phoenix LiveViews and `Phoenix.Component` function components put role gates (`:if={@is_admin}`), visibility checks, conditional classes (`class={if @active, do: "on", else: "off"}`), and rendered calculations (`{@count + 1}`) inside `~H`. Today those templates produce zero mutation sites, so UI rendering regressions and missing non-admin leak assertions go undetected. Two design facts drive this contract: 1. `mutagen_ex` ships as a zero-runtime-dependency Mix archive (`mix.exs` has no runtime deps). Scanning and splicing `~H` must live in pure Elixir without depending on `:phoenix_live_view` or `:phoenix_html`. 2. Negating `:if={expr}` alone (such as `:if={!(expr)}`) misses role-leak test gaps. A suite that only renders as an admin (`@is_admin == true`) kills `:if={!(@is_admin)}` when the admin link disappears, even though no non-admin test checks that the link stays hidden. Separate force-show (`:if={true}`) and force-hide (`:if={false}`) mutators expose both gaps independently: `:if={true}` only dies when a test asserts absence under a falsy condition, and `:if={false}` only dies when a test asserts presence under a truthy condition. ## Deliverable ### 1. Pure-Elixir inline `~H` scanner, parser, and splicer (`lib/mutagen_ex/heex.ex`) Add `MutagenEx.Heex` with zero third-party dependencies. Target static uppercase `~H` sigil nodes of shape `{:sigil_H, sigil_meta, [{:<<>>, bin_meta, [template]}, []]}` where `is_binary(template)` (ignore sigils with modifiers or non-static binary segments). Implement: - `extract(sigil_node)` returning an ordered list of extracted expression descriptors in template byte order: `%{kind: :heex_if | :heex_expr, offset: non_neg_integer(), length: pos_integer(), source: String.t(), line: pos_integer(), column: pos_integer(), end_line: pos_integer(), end_column: pos_integer()}` where `offset` and `length` are byte offsets into `template` trimmed of leading and trailing whitespace around the expression. - Scanner rules (must never raise on malformed HTML/HEEx; recover or stop cleanly): - Skip HTML comments (``), HEEx comments (`<%!-- ... --%>`), and EEx comments (`<%# ... %>`). - Skip raw-text bodies of `` and `` (still scan attributes on their opening tags). - Inside opening tags (`` as `kind: :heex_expr` when `expr` parses via `Code.string_to_quoted/2` as a complete standalone Elixir expression. Silently skip multi-tag block headers/clauses/closers (`<%= if @x do %>`, `<% else %>`, `<% end %>`, `<%= case @x do %>`) and non-output `<% ... %>` tags whose text fails standalone parsing. - Balanced-brace scanning for `{...}` must respect Elixir double-quoted strings (`"..."`), heredocs (`"""..."""`, `'''...'''`), charlists (`'...'`), quoted atoms (`:"..."`), sigils (`~s(...)`, `~r/.../`, etc.), character literals (`?{`, `?}`), backslash escapes, and `# ... \n` comments so braces inside literals or comments never prematurely close an expression. - Exact `.ex` coordinate mapping (`position_at/3` and `source_span/5`): - Account for `sigil_meta[:line]`, `sigil_meta[:column]`, `sigil_meta[:delimiter]`, and heredoc `bin_meta[:indentation]`. - For heredoc delimiters (`"\"\"\""`, `"'''"`), template line 1 starts at `sigil_meta[:line] + 1` and column `1 + Keyword.get(bin_meta, :indentation, 0)` (every subsequent line starts at column `1 + indentation`). - For single-line delimiters (`"\""`, `"'"`, `"("`, `"["`, `"{"`, `"<"`, `"/"`, `"|"`), template line 1 starts at `sigil_meta[:line]`, column `sigil_meta[:column] + 2 + byte_size(delimiter)` (subsequent lines inside a multiline non-heredoc sigil start at column 1). - Map any sub-span inside `expr` (from `MutagenEx.JsonReporter.Source.index(expr_source, file)`) back to `.ex` `(start_line, start_col)` and `(end_line, end_col)` and then to exact byte offsets in `source_text` so multiline heredoc expressions with stripped leading indentation still produce valid `source_span` slices verified by `JsonReporter`'s `r21` check. When raw-source verification would fail (for example an escaped closing delimiter inside `~H"..."`), omit `source_span` so `JsonReporter` falls back cleanly. - Shared parse and splice helpers used identically by `MutationEnumerator`, `MutationRunner`, and `Probe`: - `parse_expr(sigil_node, offset, length)` slices `binary_part(template, offset, length)` with bounds checks, computes `{line, column}`, and parses via `Code.string_to_quoted(slice, columns: true, token_metadata: true, line: line, column: column, emit_warnings: false)`. Returns `{:ok, ast}` or `:error`. - `splice_expr(sigil_node, offset, length, replacement_ast)` formats `replacement_ast` via `Macro.to_string/1`, wraps multi-statement `{:__block__, _, [_, _ | _]}` results in parentheses `"(" <> text <> ")"` (required for `Probe` wrappers inside `:if={...}` and attribute expressions), preserves newline count inside `{ ... }` / `<%= ... %>` when the replacement has fewer newlines than the replaced slice, and returns `{:ok, updated_sigil_node}`. ### 2. New catalog mutators (`heex_if_true` and `heex_if_false`) Add two high-confidence mutators implementing `MutagenEx.Mutators`: - `MutagenEx.Mutators.HeexIfTrue` (`lib/mutagen_ex/mutators/heex_if_true.ex`): - `name/0` returns `:heex_if_true`. Omit `confidence/0` to inherit default `:high`. - `match?({:__mutagen_heex_if__, meta, [_expr]}) when is_list(meta)` returns `true`; all other shapes return `false`. - `mutate/1`: if `expr` is literal `true` (bare `true` or `{:__block__, _, [true]}`), return the input `{:__mutagen_heex_if__, [], [expr]}` unchanged so `validate/1` can reject it; otherwise return `true`. - `validate/1`: returns `:ok` for `true`, `{:skip, :no_op_shadowed}` for `{:__mutagen_heex_if__, _, [expr]}` when `expr` is literal `true`, and `{:skip, :structurally_invalid}` for all other inputs. - `MutagenEx.Mutators.HeexIfFalse` (`lib/mutagen_ex/mutators/heex_if_false.ex`): - `name/0` returns `:heex_if_false`. Omit `confidence/0` to inherit default `:high`. - `match?({:__mutagen_heex_if__, meta, [_expr]}) when is_list(meta)` returns `true`; all other shapes return `false`. - `mutate/1`: if `expr` is literal `false` or `nil` (bare or `{:__block__, _, [false | nil]}`), return `{:__mutagen_heex_if__, [], [expr]}` unchanged; otherwise return `false`. - `validate/1`: returns `:ok` for `false`, `{:skip, :no_op_shadowed}` for `{:__mutagen_heex_if__, _, [expr]}` when `expr` is literal `false` or `nil`, and `{:skip, :structurally_invalid}` for all other inputs. - Register both at the end of `@mutators` in `lib/mutagen_ex/mutators.ex` (preserving existing order for the first ten mutators). - Register `:__mutagen_heex_if__ => [Mutators.HeexIfTrue, Mutators.HeexIfFalse]` in `@table` in `lib/mutagen_ex/mutators/dispatch.ex` (NOT in `@any_mutators`, so normal Elixir AST nodes pay zero overhead and never match). ### 3. Enumerator integration (`lib/mutagen_ex/mutation_enumerator.ex`) - Extend `MutagenEx.MutationEnumerator.Site.path_step` with `{:heex_expr, non_neg_integer(), pos_integer()}`. - When walking a static `{:sigil_H, _, [{:<<>>, _, [template]}, []]}` node (respecting `env.quoted`, `env.scopes`, `env.mutators`, and `env.dispatch_mode`): - Extract descriptors via `MutagenEx.Heex.extract/1` in template order. - For each descriptor, parse via `MutagenEx.Heex.parse_expr/3`; if parsing fails, skip silently without raising. - For `kind: :heex_if`: - Evaluate `:heex_if_true` and `:heex_if_false` (filtered through `env.mutators` and `env.dispatch_mode` via `{:__mutagen_heex_if__, [], [expr_ast]}`) so `:head_atom` and `:legacy` remain byte-identical. - Store `original_ast: expr_ast` (the unwrapped Elixir expression, NOT the `:__mutagen_heex_if__` wrapper), `mutated_ast: true | false`, `path: sigil_path ++ [{:heex_expr, offset, len}]`, exact `.ex` `line`, `column`, `end_line`, `end_column`, verified `source_span` / `source_line` when `env.source?` is `true`, and Scheme 2 identity `{enclosing, Mutators.identity_node(expr_ast), ordinal}` so `mix format`, reindenting `~H"""`, and surrounding HTML edits preserve site IDs. - Also walk `expr_ast` with the regular Elixir enumerator under `path: sigil_path ++ [{:heex_expr, offset, len}]` and `ambient` anchored at the expression's `{line, column}` (and `{line, column, expr_ast, end_line}` in `:planned` mode) so operators inside `:if={@role == :admin and @active}` also emit `compare`, `boolean`, etc. - Prevent duplicate mutated files when the root of `:if={expr}` is a bare boolean literal (`true` or `false`): skip `:literal` at root depth `[]` of `:if={...}` whenever `HeexIfTrue` or `HeexIfFalse` is active in `env.mutators` (`:if={true}` -> `:if={false}` is owned by `heex_if_false`, and `:if={false}` -> `:if={true}` is owned by `heex_if_true`). - For `kind: :heex_expr`: - Walk `expr_ast` with the regular Elixir enumerator under `path: sigil_path ++ [{:heex_expr, offset, len}]` and expression-anchored `ambient`, passing synthetic root context `%{parent: {:heex_expr, :expr}, index: 0}` so bare root literals like `{1}` or `disabled={true}` get stable Scheme 2 IDs. - Attach `source_span` and `source_line` for every HEEx site when `env.source?` is `true` and cached `source_text` is present. - Ensure `coverage_location/4` and `select_span/5` use the expression's exact `.ex` line range `{line, end_line}` (falling back to the enclosing branch or function clause body per `mutagen.coverage.r14` when `:cover` has no entry on the inner template line). Because `ChangedScope.planned_span/2` falls back to `{entry.line, entry.end_line || entry.line}` when `Source.line_range/2` returns `nil`, `--since` selects only the touched HEEx lines inside a multi-line `~H` block. ### 4. Runner path splicing (`lib/mutagen_ex/mutation_runner.ex`) - Extend `MutationRunner.rewrite_at_path/3` with a clause matching `{:sigil_H, sigil_meta, [{:<<>>, bin_meta, [template]}, []]} = sigil` and `[{:heex_expr, offset, len} | rest]`: - Call `MutagenEx.Heex.parse_expr(sigil, offset, len)`. Return `{:error, :site_not_found}` on `:error`. - Recursively call `rewrite_at_path(expr_ast, rest, rewrite)`. - Splice the returned mutated AST back with `MutagenEx.Heex.splice_expr(sigil, offset, len, changed)`. - Stale paths (bad offset/length, mismatched `original_ast`, non-`sigil_H` target) return `{:error, :site_not_found}` without modifying any other occurrence. ### 5. Probe instrumentation inside `~H` (`lib/mutagen_ex/probe.ex`) - Update `Probe.placement/4` so that entering `{:sigil_H, _, [{:<<>>, _, [template]}, []]} = sigil` with `[{:heex_expr, offset, len} | rest]` parses `expr_ast` via `MutagenEx.Heex.parse_expr/3` and delegates to `placement(expr_ast, rest, :expression, [{:heex_expr, offset, len} | path])`. - In `Probe.instrument/3`, ensure multiple placements inside the same `~H` sigil are applied in descending `{sigil_path, -offset}` order (right-to-left inside `template`) so splicing a later expression never shifts byte offsets of earlier expressions in the same `~H` block. - Rely on `MutagenEx.Heex.splice_expr/4` parenthesizing `{:__block__, _, [_, _ | _]}` so probed expressions compile cleanly inside `:if={(...)}`, `class={(...)}`, and `{(...)}`. ### 6. Specs, ADR, and docs - Add ADR `.spec/decisions/heex_inline_sigil_mutations.md` recording the pure-Elixir scanner, two-mutator (`heex_if_true` + `heex_if_false`) rationale, `{:heex_expr, offset, len}` path step, and explicit exclusion of `.html.heex` / multi-tag EEx blocks. Link it bidirectionally with all four specs below. - Update `.spec/specs/mutators.spec.md`: revise `r7` and `r10` for 12 mutators (9 high-confidence, 3 low-confidence), add requirements and scenarios for `heex_if_true` and `heex_if_false`, and add both new mutator modules to `surface:`. - Update `.spec/specs/mutation_enumeration.spec.md`: add `lib/mutagen_ex/heex.ex` to `surface:`, add requirements and scenarios for inline `~H` extraction, heredoc indentation source-span alignment, `:if` root-literal deduplication, Scheme 2 ID stability across `mix format`, and malformed-HEEx non-raising resilience. - Update `.spec/specs/mutation_pipeline.spec.md`: extend `r16` and scenarios to cover `{:heex_expr, offset, len}` single-site splicing and stale-path rejection. - Update `.spec/specs/coverage.spec.md`: extend `r15` to cover `Probe` right-to-left instrumentation inside inline `~H` sigils. - Update `README.md`: list `heex_if_true` and `heex_if_false` in the mutator catalog table and document inline `~H` support and limitations (standalone `.html.heex` and multi-tag EEx blocks). ## Verification 1. `test/mutagen_ex/heex_test.exs`: - Extracts `:if={...}` on HTML tags, `<.local_comp>`, ``, and `<:slot>`. - Extracts dynamic attributes (`class={...}`, `:key={...}`), dynamic spreads (`{@rest}`), body `{expr}`, and single-expression `<%= expr %>`. - Ignores HTML comments, `<%!-- ... --%>`, `<%# ... %>`, `
title: Mutate inline HEEx (~H) conditionals and embedded Elixir expressions
